provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Twilight Imperium Fourth Edition rules (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Randomly give one player the speaker token
Each player picks a faction sheet
Faction components: home system tile, 17 control tokens, 16 command tokens, faction promissory note, 2 faction technologies, faction tokens
Choose a color: its 59 units, command sheet, 25 technology cards and 4 promissory notes; merge with your faction's cards
Take the planet cards of your home system, faceup
Mecatol Rex in the center; deal system tiles for your player count
From the speaker, take turns placing tiles to build three rings, then attach home systems
steps.note: Anomalies and matching wormholes are not placed adjacent unless there is no other option

steps.text: Shuffle the action, agenda, stage I, stage II and secret objective decks separately
Supply of trade goods, fighter and infantry tokens
All 8 strategy cards faceup near the speaker
Each player: starting technologies and units from the back of the faction sheet, units in the home system
Command tokens: 3 in the tactic pool, 3 in the fleet pool, 2 in the strategy pool
First to 10 victory points wins (14 on the long side of the track)
Strategy phase: from the speaker, each player picks a strategy card
